clips.title: The story
paras: Fizziks has sealed Venture Company secrets inside the Sealed Envelope for delivery to Sputtervalve in Ratchet.

After the Venture Company cast goblin engineer Fizziks out of its logging operations in the Stonetalon Mountains, he smuggled out company secrets. The envelope holds internal manuals, operating procedures, and technical specifications. Among them are schematics for the Super Reaper 6000, a machine built for industrial clear-cutting.

Fizziks sends the documents south to Sputtervalve, an engineer in the neutral goblin port of Ratchet. The Steamwheedle Cartel's business rivals have little personal love or trust for Fizziks, yet the designs have undeniable engineering value. They reveal Venture Company mechanical ingenuity and give independent engineers a chance to exploit its advanced logging technologies.
